title: validateApp requires owner; pass team from package.json in 3 apps (single PR)

summary: validateApp now throws if owner missing/empty. core-shell, billing, reports pass owner = their package.json team (platform, payments, insights). Assumptions: team values hardcoded to match package.json (no runtime read); only the monorepo is affected (lib is inlined, platform-kit doesn't use validateApp). PR #1 merged, CI+CD green.
